messages:
maya: wrapping up my shift — quick notes before I go offline. main things changed in last 4h:
- pushed batch-config v2 to staging (uses windowed batching, reduces p99 on small requests). rollout at 03:30 UTC to prod as a canary.
- cache-evict job adjusted: runs every 6h now (was 12h). see cron below. monitor for higher DB RPS.
- small schema tweak on user_meta (nullable last_seen) — non-blocking, backfilled by migration job.

watchlist:
- watch for increased read latency to metadata DB after canary (likely within first 30m). pls alert if >10% error or latency bump +40ms p50.
- kv cache miss rate may spike after rollout. we have prefix caching enabled but eviction change could surface misses.

action items for next shift:
- @raj: confirm canary health after 03:45 UTC and either promote or rollback.
- @sam: keep an eye on the ingest pipeline; if backlog grows >5000 msgs, scale deduper squad A.
- @lee: if you see >3 alerts from the metadata DB, capture slow query and tag me.

snippet of cron for cache-evict (staging/prod):
```
0 */6 * * * /usr/local/bin/cache-evict --prefix=kv- --max-age=36h >> /var/log/cache-evict.log 2>&1
```

notes: I saw one 5xx spike tied to a transient upstream timeout at 01:12 UTC — already retried by infra and remained under SLO. no customer impact seen in logs.

leaving monitoring dashboards: https://grafana.redwood-internal/d/abc123/inference-overview (open to oncall)

thanks all, ping me if you need context. :wave:

raj: thanks — on it. will validate canary metrics and post results here.

sam: noted on backlog threshold, will have autoscaler prepped.

lee: quick q — did the migration backfill run successfully?

maya: backfill started at 02:10 UTC, ~70% done when I left. should finish in ~45m. I left a smoke check script under /home/maya/smoke/backfill-check.sh

oncall-bot: deployment canary started for batch-config v2 at 03:30 UTC — id: deploy-7753 — monitor: https://deployments.redwood/deploy-7753

sam: seeing minor uptick in kv misses in staging (p99 tokens slightly lower). I'll throttle canary if prod mirrors.

raj: will post health summary by 03:50 UTC. if no major regressions, plan is +20% traffic promotion at 04:30 UTC.

lee: can someone add a small dashboard panel for read-latency-by-region? it's currently buried.

maya: added a todo in ops board -> https://boards.redwood/ops/123 (item: expose read-latency by region)

sam: calling out that support reported one user-reported lag on a long gen at 00:58 UTC — traced to a cold-start on a remote node, not related to batch-config. flagged to infra.

maya: ok i'm off. good luck team and thanks for covering. :coffee:
